title: PrivacyGuard: Source-Linked Sanitization and Locally Resolvable PII References for Cloud GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cloud graphical user interface (GUI) agents send instructions and screenshots to remote planners, exposing personally identifiable information (PII). Existing placeholder defenses mask detected spans and reuse exact strings. Fragmented or changed forms can expose PII or break entity continuity across turns. PrivacyGuard addresses this private reference problem with source-linked sanitization (SAN) and a structured reference lifecycle (REF). SAN reconstructs fragmented or overlapping evidence and rewrites the complete source extent. REF links changed appearances to session entities and supports locally resolvable references without returning raw values to the upload path. In five-turn sessions scored against common gold, PrivacyGuard reduces audited source-value leakage by 33.55\%--82.60\% relative to the closest prior full-pipeline system in all four reader--language combinations. translated_title: PrivacyGuard：面向云GUI代理的源链接净化与本地可解析的PII引用
translated_abstract: 云图形用户界面（GUI）代理会将指令和截图发送给远程规划器，从而暴露个人身份信息（PII）。现有的占位符防御方法只是遮蔽检测到的文本片段并重复使用确切的字符串。当出现碎片化或发生变化的表单时，可能会暴露PII或破坏多轮交互中的实体连续性。PrivacyGuard通过源链接净化（SAN）和结构化引用生命周期（REF）来解决这一私有引用问题。SAN能够重建碎片化或重叠的证据，并重写完整的源范围。REF将变化后的外观链接到会话实体，并支持本地可解析的引用，而无需将原始值返回到上传路径。在以共同黄金标准评分的五轮会话实验中，在所有四种读取器-语言组合下，PrivacyGuard相较于最接近的先前完整流水线系统，将经审计的源值泄露降低了33.55%至82.60%。REF将严格的跨表单连续性从0.04大幅提升至（原文在此处截断）
tldr: PrivacyGuard针对云GUI代理的隐私泄露问题，提出源链接净化与本地可解析PII引用机制，在四种读取器-语言组合下将源值泄露降低33.55%至82.60%，并显著提升跨表单的实体连续性。
